rating_definitions.substantial: Explanation independently corroborated at primary or specialized page level, with material observation and disputed context resolved.
rating_definitions.developing: Evidence supports a coherent specific explanation but lacks critical original documentation or current-site confirmation.
rating_definitions.sparse: Only partial/institutional account or limited interpretation; chapter not narratively ready.
rating_definitions.missing: No sufficient evidence to make the requested explanation or accessible field experience.
